# Count unique opponents where the Score column is not null or empty
# First, ensure we treat missing values appropriately
# We'll filter rows where Score is not null and not an empty string (if applicable)
# Then count distinct Opponents values from those rows

# Assuming Score column may contain NaN or empty strings, we filter out those
valid_scores = df['Score'].notna() & (df['Score'].astype(str).str.strip() != '')
opponents_with_score = df.loc[valid_scores, 'Opponents'].unique()
answer = len(opponents_with_score)
